description:
Check out the red band teaser trailer for The Beekeeper 2, an upcoming film sequel starring Jason Statham, Pom Klementieff, Jemma Redgrave, Emmy Raver-Lampman, Adam Copeland, Bobby Naderi with Yara Shahidi and Jeremy Irons.

Jason Statham is back as Adam Clay in The Beekeeper 2. Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

The Beekeeper 2 is produced by Jason Statham, Chris Long, p.g.a., and Kurt Wimmer. It is executive produced by Jonathan Glickman, Thom Zadra, Alexandra Loewy, Rachael Cole, and David Ayer. Co-producers are Anthony M. Scott, Spencer Ela, and Asa Sims. The screenplay is by Kurt Wimmer and Zak Penn. The story is by Kurt Wimmer.

The Beekeeper 2, directed by Timo Tjahjanto, opens in theaters on January 15, 2027.
title: The Beekeeper 2 - Official Red Band Teaser Trailer (2027) Jason Statham, Pom Klementieff

author: IGN
description:
Historical 4X games tend to focus on a group of people you might call a nation, an empire, or indeed, a civilization. Amplitude's Humankind series is no different, but its upcoming second entry is looking at these concepts from a slightly different angle. After all, the idea of a shared identity comes from the stories we tell ourselves and each other about who we are as much as anything. And that is the starting point for charting a course through the ages in Humankind 2.

While the original Humankind and other staples of the genre typically begin with choosing a specific historical culture like the Greeks or the Egyptians, Humankind 2 is a bit different. The first choice you will make is between one of what I counted to be 19 different founding myths based on real-world oral traditions, each of which corresponds to at least one historical culture. This is the tale of how your people came to be, in their own minds.

Humankind 2 is set to release on PC in 2027.
title: Humankind 2 Rethinks One of Its Predecessor’s Most Divisive Ideas
